name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: A row of menus in one frame (Base UI Menubar): title key cells, the open title inverse, menus docked to the frame's edge with Menu's rows and checkbox and radio items.
whenToUse: Use it for a desktop-style row of menus in an application, such as File, Edit and View. For a website's navigation use Navigation menu; for a row of commands use Toolbar.

parts.name: Menubar
parts.description: A row of menus in one frame: each title is a key cell, each menu docks to the frame's edge under it. - Behaviour is Base UI Menubar: one Tab stop, Left/Right move between titles (wrapping), Down/Enter/ Space open, and while one menu is open, Left/Right and hover move to the neighbouring menu. Escape closes and returns focus to the title. - The open title is the inverse cell (Select's open caret); the menu's top border lies on the frame's bottom keyline at the frame's weight, so the two read as one shape. No cut on the menu. - Narrow: the row scrolls sideways and marks the hidden edge (scroll edges). - The rows are Menu's: import MenuItem, MenuCheckboxItem, MenuRadioGroup, MenuRadioItem, MenuSeparator, MenuGroup(Label) and MenuSubmenuRoot* from ./menu (re-exported here under Menubar names too).

parts.name: MenubarPopup
parts.description: A menu of the bar: Base UI's Portal, Positioner and Popup in one part, with the positioner's placement props lifted. It docks under its title: the frame's bottom keyline is the shared edge, and the menu's top border lies on it at the frame's weight. The surface is Menu's (MenuSurface), so it carries `data-slot="menu-popup"`.

parts.name: MenubarTrigger
parts.description: A menu's title. Rendered as another part, the element is that part's and carries its data-slot.
